race.comment: Handy race but it looks a nice option for the lightly raced BABY BLUE (10) who won her maiden at start two when last seen here, finishing strongly to score by 1.8 lengths. She can continue to progress and keep the ball rolling. FIRERATED (1) progressed nicely last start to finish a close third over 1200m at Pakenham Synthetic in similar company and should prove hard to run down on the speed. GISELLA (9) doesn't boast the best winning strike rate but ran a strong race last time out, finishing second and beaten only one length over 1200m at this track after showing speed. She should be right there again. QUBELLA (8) settled towards the tail when resuming last start then wound up strongly to score by 1.3 lengths over 1200m at Pakenham Synthetic. Hard to knock, including.
